problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Every component f_i is differentiable and convex on the entire space.

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: The objective F is μ-strongly convex, with μ>0; individual components need not be strongly convex.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: Exact component gradients at individually chosen points; replies have no stochastic or history-dependent error.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact component proximal minimizers of f_i(u)+(a/2)‖u−z‖² for any requested a>0.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: One charged query contacts at most s distinct clients, with one gradient or proximal operation per client; 1≤s≤m. All clients, including any designated anchor, consume this cap.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CappedHessianSimilarConvex.lean: Query.clients, Query.cap, Query.request, spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x,y, (1/m)∑_i ‖(∇f_i−∇F)(x)−(∇f_i−∇F)(y)‖²≤δ²‖x−y‖², with δ≥0. No absolute gradient-dissimilarity bound or component smoothness constant is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: A minimizer x⋆ exists with F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ. All parameters, including m,s,δ,μ,Δ,ε,x0, are public; component functions and proximal maps belong to the hidden instance. No function-value oracle is supplied.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return an E-valued measurable output X with integrable gap F(X)−F(x⋆), for a global minimizer x⋆, and gap expectation at most ε>0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[F(X)−F(x⋆)]≤ε under the execution's seed distribution. The extracted budget limits the number of capped oracle queries on every execution, rather than only in expectation.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines average squared gradient similarity without absolute smoothness bounds with exact component proximal access and a strict cap on all client operations per charged query.

descriptionHtml:
Capped Hessian-Similar Convex Minimization

We minimize f=m−1∑i=1mfi on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E, where m≥1 is an integer. The components fi:E→R are differentiable and convex, f is μ-strongly convex for μ>0, and the centered gradients ∇fi−∇f are jointly δ-Lipschitz in root mean square, with δ≥0. A given x0∈E has objective gap at most Δ≥0 from a minimizer x⋆. Each oracle call returns exact component gradients or proximal points for at most s∈{1,…,m} selected components. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable gap and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x),f(x)=1m∑i=1mfi(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is also equipped with a measurable structure. The algorithm receives E, m, s, δ, μ, Δ, ε, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Component convexity and strong convexity). Each fi is Fréchet differentiable everywhere. For all x,y∈E, t∈[0,1], and i∈{1,…,m}, fi((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)fi(x)+tfi(y),f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y)−μ2t(1−t)∥x−y∥2.

Assumption 2 (Mean-square similarity). Define hi(x)=∇fi(x)−∇f(x). For all x,y∈E, 1m∑i=1m∥hi(x)−hi(y)∥2≤δ2∥x−y∥2.

Assumption 3 (Initial objective gap). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Oracle access is organized into capped calls. A call selects a set S⊆{1,…,m} with |S|≤s. For each i∈S, it independently specifies a query point zi∈E and either a gradient request or a proximal request with coefficient ai>0. The corresponding exact reply is, respectively, ∇fi(zi)orproxi,ai(zi), where the proximal map satisfies, for every i, a>0, and z∈E, proxi,a(z)∈argminu∈E{fi(u)+a2∥u−z∥2}. The reply has one entry per component, with zero entries outside S. Gradient and proximal requests may be combined within a single call; the budget counts these capped calls.

After the allotted calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and its objective gap must be integrable under P. The required accuracy is EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F=m−1∑ifi has differentiable convex clients and is μ-strongly convex. For gi=∇fi−∇F, assume m−1∑i∥gi(x)−gi(y)∥2≤δ2∥x−y∥2. A minimizer x⋆ exists with F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ. Here 1≤s≤m, δ,Δ≥0, μ,ε>0. Each round contacts at most s clients, returning one gradient or exact proximal point per client. Target: ∫[F(x^(ω))−F(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, with measurable output and integrable gap.

(1) CappedHessianSimilarAccelerated (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O([1+ms+(1+m3/4s)κ]HQ) deterministic rounds
(2) AccSVRS (Lin et al. 2023), Thm. 3.6 O((m+m3/4κ)Q) expected rounds; κ≥1. (1): m→m/s; κ coefficient gains min(s,m3/4), overcoming H when this factor dominates H. Deterministic budget. (1) requires convex clients and exact proximal steps; (2) permits nonconvex clients and inexact steps. Extra factor H; worse at s=1.
(3) Derived bound: restarted, batched Acc-S-DANE (Jiang et al. 2024), Thm. 6 O(ms(1+κ)Q) deterministic rounds; δ>0. Restart the convex-client bound using D2≤2Δ/μ; 2⌈m/s⌉ rounds per iteration. (1): κ coefficient gains min(m/s,m1/4) for s≤m/2, before H. At s=m3/4,κ=m: O(m1/2log⁡mQ) versus O(m3/4Q). (1) needs exact proximal steps; expected rather than deterministic accuracy. Extra factor H; worse at s=m.
(4) Catalyst VM-SVRS (Wang 2026), Cor. 15; quadratic, individually μ-strongly convex clients O([ms+(ms+m3/4s)κ]ℓ(ℓ+Q)) expected rounds; 0<ε<Δ. (1): nonquadratic convex clients; no Lmax dependence; deterministic budget. On overlap, κ coefficient gains min(m/s,s/m1/4) for m<s<m, peaking at m1/8. (1) guarantees expected accuracy; (4) guarantees accuracy surely.

Abbr: κ=δ/μ, H=1+log⁡(2+m+κ), Q=1+log⁡(2+Δ/ε); ℓ=1+log⁡(mLmax/μ), Lmax=maxi∥∇2fi∥ for quadratics; D=∥x0−x⋆∥. Costs count capped rounds, including full passes and proximal calls; a round uses at most s primitive client calls. P is the algorithm’s randomization law.

source:
import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Strong
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.CappedHessianSimilarConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  m : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero m]
  s : ℕ
  δ : ℝ
  μ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE
  Params.nonzero

inductive Operation where
  | gradient
  | prox (coefficient : {a : ℝ // 0 < a})

structure Query (p : Params) where
  clients : Finset (Fin p.m)
  cap : clients.card ≤ p.s
  request : Fin p.m → Operation × p.E

structure Instance (p : Params) where
  components : Fin p.m → p.E → ℝ
  prox : Fin p.m → ℝ → p.E → p.E

noncomputable def objective {p : Params} (inst : Instance p) : p.E → ℝ :=
  LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective inst.components

noncomputable def centeredGradient {p : Params} (inst : Instance p)
    (i : Fin p.m) (x : p.E) : p.E :=
  gradient (inst.components i) x - gradient (objective inst) x

noncomputable def reply {p : Params} (inst : Instance p) (query : Query p)
    (i : Fin p.m) : p.E :=
  if i ∈ query.clients then
    match (query.request i).1 with
    | .gradient => gradient (inst.components i) (query.request i).2
    | .prox a => inst.prox i a.val (query.request i).2
  else 0

def Assumptions (p : Params) (inst : Instance p) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (inst.components i)) ∧
  (∀ i x, HasGradientAt (inst.components i) (gradient (inst.components i) x) x) ∧
  StrongConvexOn univ p.μ (objective inst) ∧
  (∀ x y, (1 / (p.m : ℝ)) *
    ∑ i : Fin p.m, ‖centeredGradient inst i x - centeredGradient inst i y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      p.δ ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ i a, 0 < a → ∀ z, IsMinOn
    (fun u => inst.components i u + a / 2 * ‖u - z‖ ^ 2)
    univ (inst.prox i a z)) ∧
  (∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective inst) univ xstar ∧
    objective inst p.x0 - objective inst xstar ≤ p.Δ)

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply p := Fin p.m → p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.s ∧ p.s ≤ p.m ∧ 0 ≤ p.δ ∧ 0 < p.μ ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p inst oracle := Assumptions p inst ∧
    (∀ history query seed, oracle.answer history (0, query) seed = reply inst query)
  successful p inst output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective inst) univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => objective inst (output ω) - objective inst xstar)
        (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, objective inst (output ω) - objective inst xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.CappedHessianSimilarConvex
